final:
-- Phase 2: bodies. Signatures and contracts are unchanged from the spec.
-- The caller grants io alone; no fs is declared.

format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out.char_count() > 0
  ex format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
  ex format_line("WARN", "disk low") == "[WARN] disk low"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  io.print(format_line(level: level, message: message))

test_format_line() =
  assert format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
